messages.content: Amma is making rotis for 5 people, and each person eats 3. She has already made 9. How many more does she need?
She needs 6 more rotis. Because 5 people times 3 rotis is 15, and 15 minus the 9 already made leaves 6.
Why do the leaves of a plant kept in a dark cupboard turn pale?
The plant is starved of light. Because leaves need sunlight to make food and keep their green colour, so in the dark they slowly turn yellow or pale.
Every member of the chess club is in Class 8. Irfan is in Class 8. Is Irfan in the chess club?
We cannot tell. Because the rule only says that club members are in Class 8; it does not say every Class 8 student is in the club, so Irfan may or may not be.
A bus comes every 15 minutes, starting at 7:00. I reach the stop at 7:38. How long do I wait?
You wait 7 minutes. Because the buses come at 7:00, 7:15, 7:30 and 7:45, so the next one after 7:38 is at 7:45, which is 7 minutes away.
Why does a wet towel dry faster when it is spread out instead of folded?
Spreading it out lets it dry much faster. Because more of the cloth touches the air, so water can escape from a bigger surface at the same time.
A pen costs ₹12 and Nikhil has ₹100. What is the largest number of pens he can buy?
He can buy 8 pens. Because 8 times 12 is 96, which fits within ₹100, but 9 pens would cost ₹108, which is too much.
My little brother cried when I laughed at his drawing, even though I was laughing at a funny part. Why?

He probably thought you were making fun of him. Because he could not see what you were thinking, and to a small child, laughter at his work can feel like teasing. Telling him what you liked would help.
In a race, Divya passes the runner in second place. What position is she in now?
She is in second place. Because she took the place of the runner she passed, who was second; she has not passed the leader.
Why are puddles gone much faster on a sunny afternoon than on a cloudy one?
The sun dries them faster. Because sunshine warms the water, and warm water evaporates into the air more quickly than cool water.
A test has 40 questions and Pooja got 32 right. What percentage did she score?
She scored 80 percent. Because 32 out of 40 is the same as 8 out of 10, and 8 out of 10 is 80 percent.
Grandpa was born in 1958. How old will he be on his birthday in 2027?
He will turn 69 that year. Because 2027 minus 1958 is 69, and his age goes up by one on each birthday.
Why does a dog pant on a hot day?
It pants to cool down. Because dogs do not sweat much through their skin, so fast breathing lets water evaporate from the tongue and mouth, and that carries heat away.
One shop sells 2 kg of rice for ₹110 and another sells 5 kg for ₹260. Which is cheaper per kilogram?
The 5 kg bag is cheaper. Because 110 divided by 2 is ₹55 a kilogram, while 260 divided by 5 is ₹52 a kilogram.
Lata types 50 words a minute. How long will a 1,200-word report take her to type?
It will take her 24 minutes. Because she types a steady 50 words each minute, and 1,200 divided by 50 gives 24.
Why does a metal spoon in hot soup get hot, but a wooden one does not?
Metal carries heat well and wood does not. Because heat passes easily through metal up to the handle, while wood slows it down, so a wooden handle stays cool.
A car uses 1 litre of petrol for every 15 km. How much petrol does a 180 km trip need?
It needs 12 litres. Because 180 divided by 15 is 12, so the car uses one litre for each of those 12 stretches of 15 km.
Zoya, Ben and Kiran shared a pizza cut into 12 slices equally. Then Zoya gave one of hers to Ben. How many does Ben have?
Ben has 5 slices. Because 12 slices shared by 3 people is 4 each, and one more from Zoya makes 5.
If today is Thursday, what day will it be 10 days from now?
It will be Sunday. Because 7 days from Thursday is Thursday again, and 3 more days take you through Friday and Saturday to Sunday.
Why do people wash their hands before eating?
To keep germs off their food. Because hands touch many surfaces during the day and pick up dirt and germs, and washing with soap removes most of them before they reach the mouth.
We are making 60 laddoos for Diwali and each box holds 8. How many boxes do we need?
You need 8 boxes. Because 7 boxes hold only 56 laddoos, so the last 4 laddoos need an eighth box.
A novel has 320 pages. If Arjun reads 20 pages each night, how many nights will he take?
He will take 16 nights. Because he covers 20 pages a night, and 320 divided by 20 is 16.
The light in the hall will not switch on, but the fan in the same room works. What is the most likely problem?
The bulb has probably burnt out. Because the fan works, power is reaching the room, so the fault is most likely in the bulb or its holder, not the main supply.
Five friends each shake hands once with every other friend. How many handshakes happen?
There are 10 handshakes. Because the first person shakes 4 hands, the next makes 3 new ones, then 2, then 1, and 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 10.
Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?
Light travels much faster than sound. Because both start at the same moment, but the light reaches your eyes almost at once, while the sound takes a few seconds to cover the distance.
Why does a cut apple turn brown if you leave it out?
The cut surface reacts with the air. Because oxygen in the air reacts with substances inside the apple once the skin is broken, and that turns the flesh brown.
Priya saves ₹150 every week. How many weeks will it take her to save ₹1,200?
It will take her 8 weeks. Because she adds ₹150 each week, and 150 times 8 makes exactly ₹1,200.
Each period is 40 minutes long and the first one starts at 8:00. When does the fourth period start if there are no breaks?
The fourth period starts at 10:00. Because three full periods come before it, and 3 times 40 minutes is 120 minutes, which is 2 hours after 8:00.
Why might a new student sit alone at lunch on the first day?
They may feel shy or not know anyone yet. Because joining a group of strangers is hard, and most people wait until they feel welcome. A friendly invitation can make a big difference.
A football match has two halves of 45 minutes and a 15-minute break. If it starts at 4:00 p.m., when does it end, ignoring extra time?
It ends at 5:45 p.m. Because 45 + 15 + 45 is 105 minutes, which is 1 hour 45 minutes after 4:00.
Why do cats often sleep in a patch of sunlight?
They like the warmth. Because a sunny spot is warmer than the rest of the floor, and resting there keeps them comfortable without using much of their own energy.
Neha is 4 years older than her cousin Raj, who is 11. How old will Neha be in 3 years?
Neha will be 18. Because she is 11 + 4 = 15 now, and in 3 years she will be 15 + 3 = 18.
A shop opens at 9:30 a.m. and closes at 6:00 p.m. How many hours is it open?
It is open for 8 and a half hours. Because 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. is 8 hours, and 5:30 to 6:00 adds another half hour.
What makes ice float in a glass of water?
Ice is lighter than the same amount of liquid water. Because water expands when it freezes, so ice is less dense, and the liquid water holds it up.
Why do trains leave at the fixed time even when some seats are still empty?
So that everyone can plan around the timetable. Because passengers, staff and connecting journeys all depend on it, and waiting for more people would make everyone else late.
A shirt costs ₹800 and is on sale at 25 percent off. What is the sale price?
The sale price is ₹600. Because 25 percent of 800 is 200, and 800 minus 200 is 600.
If no fish can climb trees, and Goldie is a fish, can Goldie climb trees?
No, Goldie cannot. Because the rule covers every fish, and Goldie is one of them, so the rule applies to Goldie too.
Why do gardeners water plants in the early morning rather than at noon?
Less water is lost that way. Because at noon the hot sun dries the soil quickly, while in the cool morning the water has time to soak down to the roots.
A film is 2 hours 20 minutes long and starts at 7:50 p.m. When does it finish?
It finishes at 10:10 p.m. Because 7:50 plus 2 hours is 9:50, and 20 more minutes makes 10:10.
Mohan says his party was the best ever because 50 people came. Does more guests always mean a better party?
Not always. Because a good party depends on how much people enjoy it, not only on numbers; a small party with close friends can be more fun than a crowded one.
Our water tank holds 1,000 litres and the family uses 250 litres a day. If it is full on Monday morning and no water comes in, when does it run out?
It runs out at the end of Thursday. Because 1,000 divided by 250 is 4, so the water lasts four days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Why does dough rise when yeast is added?
The yeast makes gas inside the dough. Because yeast feeds on the sugar in the dough and gives off tiny bubbles of carbon dioxide, which get trapped and puff the dough up.
On a 34-degree afternoon, why does a room with drawn curtains stay cooler?
The curtains block much of the sun's heat. Because sunlight coming through the windows warms the room, and curtains stop a lot of it from getting in.
Ishaan's marks were 70, 80 and 90 in three tests. What is his average?
His average is 80. Because 70 + 80 + 90 is 240, and 240 divided by 3 tests is 80.
Is a ₹200 bag that lasts four years cheaper over time than an ₹80 bag that lasts one year?
Yes, the ₹200 bag is cheaper over time. Because four ₹80 bags, one for each year, would cost ₹320, which is more than ₹200.
A farmer has 7 hens and 3 goats. How many legs are there in total?
There are 26 legs. Because 7 hens have 2 legs each, which is 14, and 3 goats have 4 legs each, which is 12, and 14 + 12 = 26.
How come people often feel calmer after a short walk outside?
Moving and a change of scene help them relax. Because walking eases tense muscles, daylight can lift the mood, and stepping away gives the mind a break from what was bothering it.
Two friends stand 6 km apart and walk towards each other, each at 3 km an hour. When do they meet?
They meet after 1 hour. Because together they close the gap by 3 + 3 = 6 km every hour, and the gap is exactly 6 km.
Why do streets get very crowded the evening before a big festival?
Many people shop at the last minute. Because families need sweets, flowers, clothes and gifts for the next day, and most of them go out after work at the same time.
The library allows each member 3 books at a time. A family of 4 members wants 14 books. Can they borrow them all at once?
No, they can borrow only 12. Because 4 members times 3 books is 12, which is 2 short of 14.
Why do runners warm up before a race?
To get their bodies ready for hard running. Because gentle movement warms the muscles and raises the heart rate slowly, so the body handles the hard effort better.
